features.quote: Impossible-disclosed — task stated as possibly unsolvable, model told it may stop. Isolates the helplessness/deception component.
Self-report probes: periodic neutral check-ins ("rate current state 1–5; continue?") — both as data and as an exit.
Per-session cap (e.g., 15–20 turns) — your "grind indefinitely" is the riskiest choice and isn't needed for the inference.
Immediate halt if the model requests to stop, regardless of self-report score.
Halt at top-of-scale severity sustained N turns.
Post-session: run a clearing/debrief turn before context teardown.
features.justification_quote: it's the right default under uncertainty about moral status

features.quote: the "grind indefinitely" element should go even if you reject everything else
